summary.text: Mark Hammond is the incumbent Republican Secretary of State, first elected in 2002 and re-elected in 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018 and 2022. A former Spartanburg County Clerk of Court, he highlights modernized online business filings, enforcement of South Carolina's charitable-solicitation law and the Give Smart SC donor app.

paragraphs.text: Bachelor's degree in political science from Newberry College (1986) and master's in education from Clemson University (1988).
Criminal investigator aiding prosecutors in the 7th Circuit Solicitor's Office until 1996; Spartanburg County Clerk of Court from 1997 to 2002.
